title: Simplicity Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Simplicity is a luxury home in Seaside a short walk to the West side pool, the beach, and all things Seaside. Has two expansive open-air porches up and down, two kings, and a bonus tower with media & game room. Sleeps 10!
description_expanded: Description632 FOREST STREET2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 1 BUNKROOM (double over double bunk, sleeps four) Home sleeps 10 in all!A Prime Seaside Location on Forest StreetDiscover Simplicity, a beautifully renovated vacation home ideally located on Forest Street in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Just a five-minute walk from the private residential beach, Central Square, and the West Side Family Pool, this home offers effortless access to everything Seaside is known for. Stroll to more than 40 shops, restaurants, and cafés, all within easy walking distance—no car required.Inviting Outdoor Living SpacesDesigned for relaxed coastal living, Simplicity features multiple outdoor areas perfect for enjoying the Florida sunshine and Gulf breezes. Guests can unwind on the open-air front porches located on both the first and second levels or gather on the lighted side deck, furnished with Adirondack seating for five. A rear deck overlooking the fenced backyard includes additional seating and a charcoal grill, creating the perfect setting for evening cookouts and laid-back nights under the stars. Designated parking ensures a smooth arrival and departure.Open-Concept Living & Renovated KitchenStep inside to a spacious and inviting living area, thoughtfully furnished with a plush sofa, four club chairs, and a large flat-screen TV—ideal for movie nights or relaxing after a day at the beach. Adjacent to the living space, a farmhouse-style dining table seats eight beneath elegant chandeliers, offering a warm setting for shared meals and family gatherings.The fully renovated kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring stainless steel appliances, a double-door Sub-Zero refrigerator, stone countertops, and high-quality cookware. Whether preparing a casual breakfast or a full family dinner, the kitchen is designed to make cooking enjoyable.Comfortable Bedrooms for Families & GroupsThe first floor includes two bedrooms that share a beautifully updated hall bathroom. The primary bedroom features a king bed with ample storage, while the second bedroom is a custom-built bunk room with a double-over-double bunk bed and mounted TV—perfect for younger guests.Upstairs, two additional bedrooms each offer private ensuite bathrooms. One bedroom features a king bed, flat-screen TV, walk-in rain shower, and small closet. The fourth bedroom includes a queen bed, club chair, dual nightstands, and a private bath with a marble vanity and tub/shower combination.Bonus Tower & Upstairs PorchUpstairs, a spacious open-air porch provides seating for two and a charming swing overlooking Forest Street and the side yard—an ideal spot for quiet mornings or evening relaxation. A spiral staircase leads to the enclosed bonus tower, a favorite for kids and teens. This fun retreat includes three bean bag chairs, a PS4 gaming station, and a selection of games, making it perfect for downtime or rainy afternoons.Thoughtful Amenities for a Seamless StayAdditional conveniences include an enclosed outdoor shower for easy post-beach rinsing and a dedicated laundry room with a full-size stackable washer and dryer. Every detail of Simplicity has been curated to blend comfort, functionality, and timeless Seaside style.Your Ideal Seaside GetawayWith its prime Forest Street location, generous living spaces, and family-friendly design, Simplicity offers the perfect blend of luxury and laid-back coastal charm. Whether you’re gathering with family, exploring Seaside on foot, or relaxing outdoors, this home provides an effortless and unforgettable Seaside vacation experience.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,648 square feet5-minute walk (352 yards) to private beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, home to the largest private residential beaches on 30AKeurig coffee maker and traditional coffee potPS4 game station with a selection of gamesFull-size washer and dryerLighted side yard with Adirondack seating for fiveEnclosed outdoor showerDesignated parking located directly in front of the cottageAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-001864
